llmJudge.rationale: Task failed with block:no_assistant_turn. The model entered a high-thinking reasoning loop but exhausted the reasoning budget (budget=4096 tokens) without emitting a final assistant content turn. This is a known failure mode for Gemma 4 12B with reasoning=high: even with anti-repetition sampling (--repeat-penalty 1.1 --repeat-last-n 320 --dry-multiplier 0.8), the model still produced degenerate thinking loops on some tasks. The anti-repetition fix validated in smoke testing (meeting_scheduling, conditional_logic) but caused regression on others. Score=0 because no task output was produced.
